referenceRole: Current clean city v3 textures are edit targets; retain architecture, palette and layout, repair sidewalk grounding only

A.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: opaque portrait 1024x1536 background texture for a top-down aircraft game. The reference is the EDIT TARGET. Fix ONLY the apparent floating street blocks and make all city buildings grounded on one continuous street surface.
Important invariants: preserve modern rectangular windows, flat roof shapes, real building heights/stories, the existing road route and playable central corridor, building footprints, clean large material planes, pale sunlit roofs, cool blue-gray facade shadows, greenery, a few structural ruin corners, orthographic camera and scale. Keep it a clean abandoned modern city, never a coast. Do not redesign it or flatten the building volumes.
Specific fault to remove: the whole sidewalk/forecourt has a bright thick continuous bevel and a visible vertical skirt. This reads like a separate elevated cutout platform hovering over a dark road. REMOVE that platform treatment. No white sticker-outline around the street block, no pedestal, plinth, deck, island, retaining-wall skirt, dark moat or detached drop-shadow halo. Roof parapet highlights are fine; sidewalk perimeters must not have the same bright thick bevel as roofs.
Repaint pedestrian paving, forecourts, service courtyards and asphalt as contiguous areas of the SAME GROUND PLANE. Where there is a curb, it is a narrow low ordinary gray street curb, only a few pixels wide at this scale, with minimal height and no bright white raised border. A few flush curb cuts/asphalt repair patches physically join the sidewalk/forecourt to the road. Paving joints, repair boundaries and restrained fissures continue naturally across those flush connections. Outer city lots extend to the image edges; do not outline each building block as a self-contained island.
Ground all building wall bases against the pavement using thin tight ambient-occlusion contact at the exact wall/floor joint and short coherent soft cast shadows on pavement where appropriate, upper-left daylight. Existing rubble must REST ON pavement with tiny contact shadows, not float above asphalt. Keep shadow directions and scale consistent across road, walls and objects. Do not use broad black outlines, wide dark rings, floating shadows or dirty smudged gradients as a substitute for contact.
Maintain the clean hand-painted dimensional finish. Avoid adding grunge, grime, extra tiny cracks, uniform brown dirt or random stains. Keep the intentional larger cracks and limited collapse pockets. Road remains dark desaturated blue-gray and quiet in the center. Keep top/bottom street connection positions and values compatible with the edit target for scrolling. Avoid distinctive new objects at the thin top/bottom ends.
No clouds, cloud shadows, fog, characters, aircraft, moving or parked vehicles, UI, text, logos, watermarks, alpha cutouts or transparent areas. One final full-frame game texture.
This edit is the residential and retail strip, including its recessed service courtyard.
